# MatrixQR Digital Menu Generator

> Free browser-based tool for converting restaurant, cafe, and bar menu images into QR codes with optional logo and color customization.

## Core Features

- [Menu Image to QR Code Generator](https://menu.matrixqr.cc/): Convert JPG, PNG, or WEBP menu images (up to 10 MB per file) into QR codes.
- [Cloud-hosted menu images](https://menu.matrixqr.cc/): To create a shareable QR code, the processed menu image is uploaded to Cloudflare R2 and referenced by a public URL.
- [Browser-based customization](https://menu.matrixqr.cc/): Menu images are resized and re-encoded in the browser; optional logo overlays and QR styling are rendered locally.
- [Free to use](https://menu.matrixqr.cc/): No account or subscription is required.

## Clarification & Scope

- This tool converts existing menu images into QR codes. It is not an interactive menu builder or text editor.
- The generated QR code can link to a publicly hosted image. Continued access depends on the hosted image URL remaining available.
- The page uses Google Analytics. Menu image files uploaded to generate shareable QR codes are stored in Cloudflare R2.
